title: God's Holiness
introduction: Holiness is God's most fundamental attribute - he is completely separate from all evil, absolutely pure and exalted. The seraphs cry: Holy, holy, holy! God's holiness calls us to awe, worship, and a life of purity.

sections.title: Holy, holy, holy
sections.description: The seraphs worship God with a triple cry of holiness.

sections.title: No One Is Like the Lord
sections.description: God's holiness makes him unique - no one can be compared to him.

sections.title: Holy Ground
sections.description: In meeting the holy God, we must take off our shoes.

sections.title: Called to Holiness
sections.description: Because God is holy, we are called to live holy lives.

sections.title: Sanctified in Christ
sections.description: In Christ we are sanctified and can approach the holy God.
